meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创作和编辑自定义视频组合
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要制作视频但现有工作流不匹配。
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit custom video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce video content without a specialized workflow.

howto.what: Claude会按HyperFrames流程帮你创建或编辑视频项目：初始化项目、写brief、规划场景、处理媒体和动画，支持自动化或对话式协作。
howto.when: 当没有匹配的专业视频工作流，或BRIEF.md中的flow设为companion时触发。适用于多场景视频、品牌片、蒙太奇、静态标题卡等。

say.text: 帮我创建一个30秒的品牌宣传片，三个场景。
say.note: Claude会初始化项目并逐步规划。

say.text: 在对话模式下，一起设计一个产品展示视频。
编辑现有的视频项目，修改第二场景的动画。
say.note: Claude会读取现有项目并执行修改。

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through creating or editing a HyperFrames video project: initialize project, write BRIEF.md, plan scenes, handle media and animation, supporting automated or conversational collaboration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized video workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md has flow: companion. For multi-scene videos, brand reels, montages, static title cards, etc.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second brand promo with three scenes.
say_en.note: Claude will init the project and plan step by step.

say_en.text: Design a product showcase video in companion mode.
say_en.note: Claude will act as a director and collaborate.

say_en.text: Edit the second scene's animation in an existing project.
say_en.note: Claude will read the project and apply changes.
